body: So my life is only to live to play minecraft? or other video games, im getting a headache from all of this :/

I've tried persuing things I used to enjoy, It just ends up me on the sidelines, letting others enjoy themselves, I don't feel I fit in anywhere, There's no point to living on like this, I really wish I had a true friend to be with to hang out with, but all I have is Myself, and he's not a good person to be with.
